newsitem.title: UK: C&W shares firm after One 2 One update.
newsitem.headline: C&W shares firm after One 2 One update.

text.p: Shares in Cable & Wireless were higher on Monday after the company's One 2 One mobile telephone unit reported its highest ever quarterly net growth in new subscribers.
The shares were 8p higher at 475p by 1339 GMT, after 2.8 million had changed hands.

A company spokesman said One 2 One had added 85,000 subscribers in the final quarter of 1996 compared with 35,000 in the corresponding quarter in 1995. The company said its share of the UK cellular market was now eight percent.
Shares in other mobile phone companies were also strong.
